summary: Localized numeric input: parses and formats with Intl.NumberFormat (currencies, percentages, units), clamps to min/max and increments with buttons, arrow keys and the mouse wheel.
whenToUse: Quantities, amounts, percentages with optional limits.
whenNotToUse: Numeric codes (ZIP code, phone, IBAN): use TextField with inputMode="numeric".
Approximate values within a range: use Slider.
accessibility: Buttons have localized labels and are excluded from the Tab order (avoiding redundant stops).
The formatted value is read by screen readers.
responsive: Numeric/decimal keyboard on mobile depending on the format.
customization: Tabular figures; value centered when buttons are visible.
commonMistakes: Expecting onChange on every keystroke: it fires on commit.
Using it for identifiers with leading zeros.
